decisions.reason: It remains relevant to the firm's core automation and data-handling offer, but its overlap with other software modules and weak later visibility make consolidation a meaningful risk.
The safety-focused hardware fits municipal infrastructure projects and complements the installed base, though it is less central than software and control products to the firm's strategic direction.

This is a credible but relatively narrow wastewater niche product, and in a portfolio moving toward more connected and software-led infrastructure solutions it is the clearest candidate to release resources.
Control technology for water engineering machinery sits close to the firm's core integrated machinery-and-automation business and supports its system responsibility in customer projects.

Flow measurement automation and system software is strongly aligned with the firm's move toward connected, web-based and data-driven infrastructure management, so it should remain strategically important.
